verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising modeling product documents pro-forma modeling for a priced round or SAFE, plus pre- and post-financing scenario models, which covers the core of the story. Several named elements are not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling, explicit SAFE-conversion mechanics within a priced round, any documented way to share a scenario with counsel or investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors

citations.quote: Get a pro-forma for your next priced round or SAFE.
Run models for complex pre-financing, post-financing, or exit scenarios.
Use Pulley's powerful fundraising modeling software to explore the full spectrum of possible scenarios and understand the impact of your choices.
